column3: “like God” may also be rendered “like gods.”
“in the cool of the day” renders “at the wind (breeze) of the day.”
“seed” renders “offspring,” and “bruise” renders a verb of uncertain meaning used in both lines.
“your pain in childbirth” renders “your pain and your conception.”
“In toil” renders “in pain,” the same word as in verse 16.
the sentence breaks off in the Hebrew, as NASB's dash shows.
